name: Campingplatz Bad Neunbrunnen
beschreibung: The Bad Neunbrunnen campsite is located in the tranquil municipality of Maishofen, nestled in the impressive mountain landscape of Pinzgau. The surroundings offer an ideal starting point for hikes, bike tours and excursions to the nearby Zeller See. The amenities include a private natural swimming lake, modern sanitary facilities, a grocery store and a restaurant. The spacious pitches are partly terraced and guarantee plenty of privacy and a magnificent mountain view. The quiet and close-to-nature atmosphere contributes significantly to guests' relaxation. The campsite is aimed mainly at families, couples and active holidaymakers who value a comfortable pitch in an idyllic Alpine landscape.
